lines: Japan, long ago. Two woodcutters are trapped in a deadly blizzard.
They shelter in a tiny hut as the snow howls.
At night the door flies open. A tall woman in white glides in.
Her skin is pale as ice. Her breath is frost.
She bends over the old man, and he never wakes.
Then she spares the young one, Minokichi, if he never tells a soul.
Years later, he has a kind wife named O-Yuki.
One snowy night, he tells her about the woman he once met.
She rises, eyes burning blue. It was me, she whispers, and fades into the wind.
Would you have kept the secret?
title: The Snow Woman Who Spared One Man, Then Came Back... ❄️ #shorts
description:
In an old Japanese folktale, a woodcutter meets the Yuki-onna, a pale snow spirit, in a blizzard. She lets him live on one condition: he must never tell. This is the legend of the Snow Woman.
